statusLegend.VERIFIED_DEMO: Feature slice has local evidence; read its actual/evidence fields for limits.
statusLegend.IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED: Relevant code/UI exists, but required demo action lacks current evidence; NOT_RUN is not missing implementation.
statusLegend.INCOMPLETE_DEMO: Current demo profile disables or breaks a needed path, even if source code exists.
statusLegend.MISSING: Required functionality is absent from the inspected source/UI.
statusLegend.EXTERNAL_ONLY: Requires provider/device/staging beyond this local demo.
